summary: Treat TS private/protected parameter properties as ordinary runtime properties.

target.notes: Model observable JavaScript emitted by TypeScript first, then reuse canonical JS class/module/object semantics.

tests.name: private via any
tests.input: class C { constructor(private x:number){} }; console.log((new C(3) as any).x);

tests.name: protected via any
tests.input: class C { constructor(protected y:number){} }; console.log((new C(4) as any).y);
